validationSummary.task: Retrospective context-assisted teammate-gap prediction, not unseen-weekend forecasting

limitations: Not a cross-team ranking or race-driving quality score.
Observed weekend gaps combine driving, equipment differences, conditions and incidents.
Season intervals are model-dependent credible intervals; predictive validation does not establish their exact coverage.
Retrospective predictive coverage was 93.8% overall, with seasonal variation; future-weekend forecasting undercovers recent seasons.
All evaluated historical periods are now development evidence; prospective confirmation remains outstanding.
